messages:
Maya Liu: Quick sync — finalizing co-marketing plan for our CloudShop marketplace listing + integration demo.
Alex Kim: Outline: webinar (60m), 25m demo, 20m panel, 15m Q&A? maybe shorten demo to 20.
Samir Patel: Agree. Need to lock partner speaker (CloudShop PM) by EOD Fri.
Jordan Reyes: I'll draft the co-blog outline: intro, value props, benchmark summary, integration steps, CTA + demo embed.
Maya Liu: Inbound routing: HubSpot form -> workflow tag 'cloudshop_integration' -> assign to Partner SDR queue. Priya to confirm.
Priya Nair: Confirmed. Need final UTMs and form fields by Thu. Also we need partner contact email for direct lead handoff.
Alex Kim: UTMs: use campaign=cloudshop_integration, source=webinar, content=partnerdemo
Jordan Reyes: I'll include this example in the runbook:

```
https://redwood.ai/launch?utm_campaign=cloudshop_integration&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_content=partnerdemo
```

Samir Patel: For benchmark narrative: focus on latency/cost improvements vs 'vanilla host' with our batching & cache. Jordan will take lead on metrics.
Jordan Reyes: Will gather: 99th latency, tokens/sec, cost/token across three model configs. Need runtime team numbers by Wed.
DevOps Bot: @runtime-team please share perf table: seq_len=256 baseline vs optimized (batched+kv cache). Respond with CSV.
Alex Kim: Marketing assets: 1) Webinar slides 2) Short 90s demo video 3) Co-blog 4) Social kit. Owners: Maya(slides), Jordan(blog), Dev (video), Alex(social).
Maya Liu: Rehearsal schedule: Wed next week 10:00 PT tech check, Fri 10:00 PT dry run with partner.
Priya Nair: I'll set calendar invites and add partner contact.
Samir Patel: Lead routing test: we'll run 3 fake submissions after staging deploy. Priya to confirm test emails.
Priya Nair: Test emails: partner+internal@redwoodtest.com
Jordan Reyes: Need copy for registration confirmation + follow-up sequences. Draft will be posted in this thread by Tue.
Maya Liu: One more — can we get a 30s clip of the integration flow exported as MP4? Dev, is that doable by Thursday?
DevOps Bot: @eng-media yes, please open ticket #ENG-4228 and tag media.
Alex Kim: Social cadence: pre-announce 2 weeks, reminders 1 week, 3 days, day-of, replay next day. Use short clips + quote cards.
Samir Patel: Tracking: create a shared spreadsheet for leads with columns: name,email,company,utm,assigned_to,status,notes
Jordan Reyes: I'll create the sheet and share.
Maya Liu: Great. Action items: Samir lock partner speaker; Dev produce video + perf CSV; Jordan metrics + blog draft; Priya lead routing + invites; Alex social kit.
Alex Kim: Noted. Will sync with design for assets.
Samir Patel: If partner needs slides template, ping me.
Maya Liu: Thanks team. We'll reconvene Fri after dry run. :rocket:
